title: Coproduct preservation for proper étale derived direct image
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $g : Z \to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). On the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(Z_{\Et},A)$ and $D(Y_{\Et},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the total right derived direct image $Rg_*$ preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts. Its bounded-below restriction is the derived direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: proper derived direct image preserves arbitrary coproducts before Brown representability

proof.text: Apply [pqf-lem-proper-basic] to $g$: it is quasi-compact, quasi-separated and of finite type. The target $Y$ is quasi-compact by the Noetherian hypothesis. Apply [lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound] to obtain an integer $e\geq0$ bounding the dimensions of every scheme-theoretic fibre; empty fibres are allowed.

Because $A$ is finite, some positive integer $N$ annihilates $A$. Every $A$-module sheaf is therefore torsion as an abelian sheaf. Apply [lem-kun-proper-torsion-cd-bound] to obtain vanishing of higher direct images above $2e$, and use [lem-sbc-higher-direct-image-forget-comparison] to transfer the vanishing from abelian sheaves to $A$-module sheaves.

Apply [lem-exc-direct-image-coproducts] with $u=g$, coefficient ring $A$, and bound $c=2e$. Its finite-amplitude unbounded derived argument gives preservation of every set-indexed coproduct, including the empty family. The bounded-below comparison with the direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is the canonical right-derived-functor comparison.

The correction restores exactly those hypotheses and clauses.

theorem proper_rightDerivedLowerStar_preservesCoproducts
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (r : V ⟶ T) [IsProper r]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V] [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T] :
    (∀ I : Type w, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)) ∧
    Nonempty
      (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r ⋙
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ≅
        _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)
